messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (signal) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is this a problem with Keelwater's product that a squad could act on? Pass means yes.
Fail if the cause is outside the product (pricing, contracts, the customer's own IT, staffing), if a help article would have answered it, or if it is praise.
A feature request or a described workaround is signal.
The evidence is the title, the problem statement and up to 12 customer quotes with route and date.
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "problem_statement": "Hi Alwen, just checking in — we’re still waiting on the document upload permissions for our policyholders’ claims portal. We’ll need to lock in a time next week for the integration walkthrough — can Tuesday at 11 work for you?",
 "quotes": [
  {
   "date": "2026-10-16T12:52:00Z",
   "quote": "Hi Alwen, just checking in — we’re still waiting on the document upload permissions for our policyholders’ claims portal. We’ll need to lock in a time next week for the integration walkthrough — can Tuesday at 11 work for you?",
   "route": "sales"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-09-03T09:38:00+00:00",
   "quote": "That would be helpful — I’m managing several claims with lots of supporting documents, and doing them one by one is slowing things down.",
   "route": "support"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-10-19T10:29:00Z",
   "quote": "Will do — thanks again.",
   "route": "sales"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-09-06T10:46:00+00:00",
   "quote": "Can you walk me through how to assign roles to new claims handlers in the dashboard?",
   "route": "support"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-10-11T13:36:00+00:00",
   "quote": "That would help — we need to reconcile this before month-end. Appreciate the quick follow-up.",
   "route": "support"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-10-06T16:28:00Z",
   "quote": "No problem. Let me know if you need any logs or screenshots from our end.",
   "route": "sales"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-10-22T08:16:00Z",
   "quote": "Hi Alwen, just checking in — we’ve been running claims through your system for three months now and it’s been smoother than expected. We’re evaluating whether the per-claim fee structure aligns with our volume projections for next year. Your team’s responsiveness during our onboarding was genuinely impressive and made a big difference.",
   "route": "sales"
  }
 ],
 "title": "Hi Alwen, just checking in — we’re still waiting on the document"
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "The title and problem statement describe a customer waiting on document upload permissions and scheduling an integration walkthrough — this is an onboarding/administrative request routed through sales, not a product defect a squad could act on. The 2026-09-03 quote ('doing them one by one is slowing things down') hints at a possible bulk-upload gap, but it is vague and not clearly tied to the stated problem; the other quotes are scheduling chatter, a how-to question answerable by support, and praise. The 2026-10-22 quote is explicitly praise plus a pricing evaluation, which fails on its own. No clear actionable product problem emerges from the evidence.", "verdict": "fail"}
